diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency on the launch template duplicates the direct attribute-reference dependency already established by the launch_template_specification in this autoscaling group.
The explicit dependency on the node-group IAM role duplicates the direct attribute-reference dependency from node_role_arn.
The explicit dependency on the Fargate IAM role duplicates the direct attribute-reference dependency from pod_execution_role_arn.
The explicit dependency on the node-group IAM role is already established transitively through the launch template, which depends on the instance profile and role.
The explicit dependency on the EKS cluster is already established transitively through the autoscaling group, which itself references the cluster.

When enable_ssm is true, this self-managed node group installs and starts the SSM agent, but its autoscaling group does not wait for the SSM managed-instance policy attachment. Instances can start before the role has the permissions needed for SSM registration.

When enable_ssm is true, the managed node group's launch template installs and starts the SSM agent, but the node group does not wait for the SSM managed-instance policy attachment. Nodes can start before their role has the permissions needed for SSM registration.
